name: prometheus-viewer
changelog:
v4: the dashboard follows the person's light or dark theme (D184, <html data-bx-theme="auto">), drawn from the workspace's tokens, fonts and 2px corners; the live mark is the accent square (it no longer pulses), sparklines draw in the first chart colour, a metric's type is a square badge in words, and a scrape error carries its icon (the native view's, words only)
v3: the dashboard takes the workspace's thin themed scrollbars (D123)
v2: a native view for the xbin app (native.js): a section per source, a disclosure per metric, native sparklines; the binding, scrape, parser, rate math and formatters moved into prom.js, shared by the page and the native view — the page behaves as before
title: Prometheus Viewer
description: Live dashboard for Prometheus metrics. Pure frontend — bind one or more components that export a "prometheus" metrics service (e.g. llm-gw) and it scrapes their /metrics endpoints, showing current values (counters with a per-second rate, gauges instantaneous) plus a client-side sparkline of recent samples.
